versions.content: EcucDestinationUriPolicy.destinationUriNesting- Contract is set to leafOfTargetContainer If the attribute EcucDestina- tionUriPolicy.destinationUriNestingContract is set to leafOfTarget- Container , then the attributes • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.container , • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.reference , and • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.parameter are expressing the constraints applicable for the direct child elements of Ecuc- ContainerDef that wants to become a target for the enclosing EcucDestina- tionUriDef (this EcucDestinationUriDef has to have the same child elements as the EcucDestinationUriPolicy ), but not to the EcucContainerDef itself. In other words, all aggregations in the roles • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.container • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.reference • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.parameter shall be represented in the EcucContainerDef (target of URI-based reference), but this EcucContainerDef may define additional child elements that have no correspon- dence (identified by a matching pair of shortName s) in the definition of the EcucDes- tinationUriPolicy .
